name: axum
description_en: HTTP routing and request-handling library for Rust that focuses on ergonomics and modularity
readme_excerpt: axum axum is an HTTP routing and request-handling library that focuses on ergonomics and modularity. [ ][docs] More information about this crate can be found in the [crate documentation][docs].
